content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 6.11 (Audit) largely meets the playbook — once-per-period frequency cap, independent nationally-recognized auditor reasonably acceptable to us, limited disclosure to Harpoon, confidentiality via Section 6.13, records-only scope (no system access), and Harpoon bearing cost absent a variance threshold. The gap is notice: the audit is triggered merely "at the request of Harpoon," with no advance notice or business-hours limit, which falls short of even the fallback (15 days) and edges toward unannounced audits. Redline validated (ok:true) inserting 30 days' prior written notice and a normal-business-hours limitation, with 15 days offered as fallback. Our reciprocal inspection right over Harpoon's records (Section 3.8.6) benefits us and was not flagged.
